preamble: No genuine sound change of the diphthong [ou] directly to the labio-velar glide [w] has been verified. The only evidence previously cited was orthographic: in Nubi writing the digraph ⟨ou⟩ (borrowed from French-style spelling conventions) can represent either /w/ or /u/. That is a spelling convention, not a phonetic shift. Glide formation of a high back vowel before another vowel belongs under u_to_w.

examples.note: Orthographic correspondence only: the digraph ⟨ou⟩ writes either /w/ or /u/. No historical [ou] > [w] change is involved.

sources: Tosco, M., & Owens, J. (1993). Linguistic studies in Nubi. Rüdiger Köppe Verlag.
